title: Dinosaur holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='balloonGrad' cx='35%' cy='30%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff8a8a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e03030'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M74 40 Q70 55 66 68' stroke='#cfd8e3' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none'/>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='75' cy='28' rx='13' ry='15' fill='url(#balloonGrad)'/>
  <path d='M73 43 L77 43 L75 47 Z' fill='#b02020'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='22' rx='3.5' ry='5' fill='#ffc9c9' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M20 78 Q8 82 6 70 Q14 72 18 64 Q22 68 26 60 Q30 68 34 74 Z' fill='#2fa84f'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='30' y='76' width='9' height='14' rx='4' fill='#238f41'/>
  <rect x='46' y='76' width='9' height='14' rx='4' fill='#238f41'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='90' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#1c7a36'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='90' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#1c7a36'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='64' rx='20' ry='17' fill='#2fa84f'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='68' rx='12' ry='11' fill='#a8e6b8'/>
  <!-- arm holding string -->
  <path d='M58 58 Q66 60 66 68' stroke='#2fa84f' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- hand -->
  <circle cx='66' cy='68' r='3.5' fill='#238f41'/>
  <!-- back spikes -->
  <path d='M26 56 L20 50 L30 50 Z' fill='#f2b632'/>
  <path d='M24 46 L19 40 L29 41 Z' fill='#f2b632'/>
  <path d='M30 38 L28 30 L36 36 Z' fill='#f2b632'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='36' rx='17' ry='14' fill='#2fa84f'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='40' rx='10' ry='7' fill='#3cc060'/>
  <!-- nostrils -->
  <circle cx='62' cy='38' r='1.3' fill='#1c7a36'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='42' r='1.3' fill='#1c7a36'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='48' cy='32' r='4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='49' cy='32' r='2.2' fill='#123c6e'/>
  <circle cx='49.7' cy='31.2' r='0.7' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M52 44 Q56 48 61 44' stroke='#1c7a36' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
